newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P affirms Gullspang paper rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Gullspang paper rating.

text.p: U.S. credit ratings agency Standard and Poor's on Thursday affirmed Swedish power company Gullspang Kraft AB's commercial paper rating at K-1 and removed the rating from creditwatch.
S&P said the rating was placed on credit watch with negative implications on July 25 this year.

The agency said the move reflected the fact the acquisition of Skandinaviska Elverk (SEV) substantially improves Gullspang's customer mix in favour of retail sales, the least competitive segment in the deregulated electricity market.
"Furthermore the purchase also will lead to cost reductions within electricity production and increase Gullspang's hydro power reservoir capacity," S&P said in a statement.
"These elements somewaht mitigate the negative financial aspect ot this acqusition on Gullspang."

The new Gullspang group including the SEV acquisition had a combined production of 10,800 Gwh in 1995 and is the third largest electricity producer in Sweden accounting for eight percent of national electricity generation.
S&P said after the purchase of SEV, the Gullspang group benefits from a local monopoloy for distribution of electricity to some 355,000 end customers in west and central Sweden.
Gullspang bought SEV from Incentive AB in July this year for 4.2 billion crowns.
